'''Kladak''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord during the time of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> He represented the Hutt Cartel and his own interests to the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] organizing the [[Colicoid War Games]]. He was accompanied by other Cartel-aligned thugs.
